title: Panic: stop everything
description: Press Shift five times, with no more than half a second between presses and no intervening button or pad press. This shortcut reaches Panic only if the current screen lets the Shift events reach global fallback handling.

dispatch.press: Fifth eligible press consumed; earlier presses continue through ordinary Shift handling.

lifecycle.completion: Reset the counter, clear sticky Shift, invoke AudioEngine::panic, and suppress the fifth release.
lifecycle.cancellation: Other button presses reset before UI dispatch; pad handling resets through ignoreCurrentShiftForSticky.
lifecycle.timeout: A gap greater than kShortPressTime restarts the count at one on the next eligible press.
